property_summary: For every call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later timestamp, the reference contract only transfers its full balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0 (so on other blocks the contract's balance remains >0), whereas the mutant transfers on block.number % 10 == 0 and therefore can drain the contract on some blocks where the reference would not.
change_summary: Change the transfer condition to use modulus 10 instead of 15 so transfer occurs on different blocks.
